title: Figure 9: Object Sightings Among Four Sighting Reliability Groups, All Years and Each Year
description: Stacked percentage bar chart with bars for "All years" and each year 1947–1952, divided into reliability groups labeled Excellent, Good, Doubtful and Poor. The y-axis is "Per Cent" (0–100), and the number of object sightings appears above each bar (2199, 79, 143, 186, 169, 121, 1501). Dashed lines connect group boundaries from year to year. Caption: "FIGURE 9 DISTRIBUTION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS AMONG THE FOUR SIGHTING RELIABILITY GROUPS FOR ALL YEARS AND EACH YEAR"; drawing A-7487.
